query: select i.config from invitations i where i.id = $1 and i.deleted_at is null and (i.user_id = $2 or exists (select 1 from invitation_members m where m.invitation_id = i.id and m.user_id = $2 and m.revoked_at is null and m.role = any($3)) or exists (select 1 from workspace_members wm join workspaces w on w.id = wm.workspace_id where w.id = i.workspace_id and w.owner_user_id = i.user_id and w.disabled_at is null and wm.user_id = $2 and wm.revoked_at is null and wm.role = any($4)))
